mapper.select: SELECT * FROM pur_order_import_batch WHERE country_id=#{countryId} AND batch_id=#{batchId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT effective_header FROM pur_order_import_group WHERE country_id=#{countryId} AND batch_id=#{batchId}
SELECT count(*) FROM fin_book WHERE country_id=#{countryId} AND id=#{id} AND status='ACTIVE'
SELECT count(*) FROM md_supplier WHERE country_id=#{countryId} AND id=#{id} AND status='ENABLED'
SELECT count(*) FROM md_currency WHERE code=#{code} AND status='ENABLED'
mapper.update: UPDATE pur_order_import_batch SET status='PARSING',updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE country_id=#{countryId} AND batch_id=#{batchId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM pur_order_import WHERE country_id=#{countryId} AND batch_id=#{batchId} ORDER BY row_no
SELECT * FROM pur_order_import_group WHERE country_id=#{countryId} AND batch_id=#{batchId} ORDER BY id

SELECT id,file_name,file_sha256,parser_version,status,sheets,warnings,associations,error_code,error_message,coalesce(parse_options->>'origin','XLSX') AS origin FROM pur_order_import_source WHERE country_id=#{countryId} AND batch_id=#{batchId} ORDER BY id

SELECT t.id,t.kind,t.phase,t.status,t.attempt_count,t.error_code,t.error_message,t.result,t.source_id,s.file_name,p.snapshot||jsonb_build_object('attemptCount',p.attempt_count,'updatedAt',p.updated_at) AS progress_snapshot FROM pur_order_import_task t LEFT JOIN pur_order_import_source s ON s.country_id=t.country_id AND s.id=t.source_id LEFT JOIN pur_order_import_task_progress p ON p.country_id=t.country_id AND p.task_id=t.id AND p.attempt_count=t.attempt_count WHERE t.country_id=#{countryId} AND t.batch_id=#{batchId} ORDER BY t.created_at

SELECT i.id,i.image_sha256,r.association_status,r.anchor,r.publish_status,r.product_image_id,r.publish_product_id,r.publish_error,coalesce(s.parse_options->>'origin','XLSX') AS origin FROM pur_order_import_row_image r JOIN pur_order_import_image i ON i.country_id=r.country_id AND i.id=r.image_id JOIN pur_order_import_source s ON s.country_id=i.country_id AND s.id=i.source_id WHERE r.country_id=#{countryId} AND r.row_id=#{rowId} ORDER BY i.id
SELECT * FROM pur_order_import WHERE country_id=#{countryId} AND batch_id=#{batchId} AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE pur_order_import SET source_order_no=#{sourceOrderNo},photo=#{photo},product_spec=#{productSpec},purchase_qty=#{purchaseQty},sale_unit_price=#{saleUnitPrice},sale_total=#{saleTotal},purchase_unit_price=#{purchaseUnitPrice},freight=#{freight},landed_unit_cost=#{landedUnitCost},usd_unit_cost=#{usdUnitCost},usd_total=#{usdTotal},field_origins=#{fieldOrigins}::jsonb,decision='UNRESOLVED',readiness='UNRESOLVED',confirmed_by=NULL,confirmed_at=NULL,product_snapshot=NULL,version=version+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE country_id=#{countryId} AND id=#{id}

UPDATE pur_order_import SET supplied_product_code=#{suppliedProductCode},supplied_product_name=#{suppliedProductName},supplier_product_code=#{supplierProductCode},field_origins=#{fieldOrigins}::jsonb WHERE country_id=#{countryId} AND id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM pur_order_import WHERE country_id=#{countryId} AND batch_id=#{batchId} AND target_order_line_id IS NOT NULL
SELECT id,version FROM pur_order_import WHERE country_id=#{countryId} AND batch_id=#{batchId} ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE pur_order_import_batch SET header=#{header}::jsonb WHERE country_id=#{countryId} AND batch_id=#{batchId}

UPDATE pur_order_import SET book_id=#{bookId},supplier_id=#{supplierId},currency=#{currency},order_date=#{orderDate}::date,expected_date=#{expectedDate}::date,payment_terms=#{paymentTerms},prepay_ratio=#{prepayRatio}::numeric,term_days=#{termDays},version=version+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE country_id=#{countryId} AND batch_id=#{batchId}
UPDATE pur_order_import_group SET effective_header=#{effectiveHeader}::jsonb WHERE country_id=#{countryId} AND batch_id=#{batchId} AND header_override=false AND target_order_id IS NULL
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM pur_order_import WHERE country_id=#{countryId} AND id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM pur_order_import_group WHERE country_id=#{countryId} AND batch_id=#{batchId} AND create_status IN ('UNKNOWN','CREATING')
SELECT count(*) FROM pur_order_import_group WHERE country_id=#{countryId} AND id=#{id} AND create_status IN ('UNKNOWN','CREATING')
mapper.update: UPDATE pur_order_import_group SET preview_token=NULL,preview_snapshot=NULL,create_status='DRAFT',version=version+1 WHERE country_id=#{countryId} AND batch_id=#{batchId} AND target_order_id IS NULL AND create_status NOT IN ('CREATING','UNKNOWN')
UPDATE pur_order_import_batch SET version=version+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE country_id=#{countryId} AND batch_id=#{batchId}

choose.when: SELECT a.* FROM pur_order_import_image i JOIN pur_order_import_source s ON s.country_id=i.country_id AND s.id=i.source_id JOIN sys_attachment a ON a.country_id=i.country_id AND a.id=i.attachment_id WHERE i.country_id=#{countryId} AND s.batch_id=#{batchId} AND i.id=#{assetId} AND a.status='VALID' AND a.object_status='AVAILABLE'
choose.otherwise: SELECT a.* FROM pur_order_import_source s JOIN sys_attachment a ON a.country_id=s.country_id AND a.id=s.attachment_id WHERE s.country_id=#{countryId} AND s.batch_id=#{batchId} AND s.id=#{assetId} AND a.status='VALID' AND a.object_status='AVAILABLE'

mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM pur_order_import_row_image WHERE country_id=#{countryId} AND row_id=#{rowId} AND image_id=#{imageId} AND product_image_id IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE pur_order_import_row_image SET association_status=#{associationStatus},confirmed_by=#{confirmedBy},confirmed_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE country_id=#{countryId} AND row_id=#{rowId} AND image_id=#{imageId}
UPDATE pur_order_import SET version=version+1 WHERE country_id=#{countryId} AND id=#{id}
